# Prior Cognitive Art

A conceptual manuscript about explaining priors across mechanism, function,
history, and fixed-point organization. The publication uses deterministic
diagrams and one authored illustrative trace.

- [Documentation](docs/README.md)
- [Manuscript sources](docs/manuscript/README.md)
- [Local publication build](docs/rendering_pipeline.md)

## Testing

```bash
uv run --extra dev pytest tests/ --cov=src
```

The project test suite covers the conceptual inventory, generated artifacts,
hydration, rendering contracts, source-owned visual metadata, freshness gates,
and publication-package negative controls.
